responsibility: This definition module declares the quiet-mode wrappers around mcPrintf. It exports the same small family of formatted print entry points, but intended for progress and informational output that should be suppressed when the user selects quiet compilation.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is only the Modula-2 interface for the mcQuiet stem, declaring the qprintf0..qprintf4 entry points; unlike mcQuiet.mod, it contains no quiet-checking logic or forwarding to mcPrintf.
